heading: Rule 2 — the constant-space gate
text:
### Rule 2 — the constant-space gate [LCAP.3.2]

The constraints in the following table are compile errors under
`constspace: true`, and so under `realtime: true`, which requires it
([LCAP.3.7]), whatever `linear_scan` is set to ([LNLS.2.3]):

| Constraint | Reason |
|---|---|
| No novel strings (LNLS.3.2) | Intern table bounded; under `realtime` it is locked after go_live, and a novel string → DS_ERR_OOM |
| No sketch backends (LNLS.3.5) | O(n) compaction is unbounded; cannot appear in T_wcet |
| No unbounded regex (LNLS.3.7) | O(L×P) with run-time L; must have `capacity` to bound |
| No unbounded string ordering (LNLS.3.8) | O(len) strncmp; must have `capacity` |
| No JSON_PATH (LNLS.3.9) | Unbounded allocation |

Constraints the constant-space gate does **not** include: LNLS.3.1 (no JSON
slots), LNLS.3.3 (identity join),
LNLS.3.10 (bounded strings for all string ops). These apply under
`linear_scan: false`.
